top_signals.title: Higher Bond Yields Will Pressure Australia Budget, Chalmers Says
top_signals.summary: Higher global bond yields will put pressure on the Australian budget as debt refinancing costs rise, according to Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
